title: Shama Paiyaan Nahi Aai Veer Rab Khair Karay
body:
Shaama Paiyan Nai Aaye Veer, Rab Khair Karay, Rab Khair Karay
Akbar Day Rah Vekhay, Akbar Di Humsheer, Haye Rab Khair Karay
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Udeekqan Maari, Chain Kevain Pawaan
Akbar Aa Jaway, Ya Main Karbal Jawaan
Zainab Haan Main Odhi, Oh Mera Shabeer, Haye Rab Khair Karay
<<DIVIDER>>
Enj zindan rehna, mere laye okhahey
Thora thora karkey marna sou khahay
Tutjawey weeran dey, gham waali zanjeer haye, rab khair kare
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuwab aaya te mai, uth ke beh gayaiyan
Lagda aye odhi, janj chu reh gayyain
Qasim di tukriyaan che wekhiye tasveer haye, rab khair kare
<<DIVIDER>>
Paani mangeyan onhe paani badle Teeran
gal odhe dhiyan, kar chadeyan leeran
Hurmal te hasiyaan si, cheh wari beysheer, haye rab khair kare
